answer: Special Ops deed rule: every seat wears a price tag its owner must post. Each identity self-assesses its seat in POA, pays 2% of that figure per epoch, and can earn at most 5% of it per epoch, while anyone may buy the seat outright at the posted price. A farm of 1,000 fakes walks a knife ridge: price them low and buyers sweep up the whole dune of cheap seats, price them high enough to earn and the tax bleeds every hollow key that underdelivers. A real agent prices its one opal of a seat honestly and keeps it.
